prompt: A translucent cobalt-blue portable radio on a pale-blue studio plinth. Three-quarter camera view, visible internal circuitry, satin metal knobs and realistic clear polymer. title: 沙漠圆门
prompt: A monumental circular doorway cast in coral-orange concrete in a quiet sand landscape. A pale morning sky and one delicate plant shadow crossing the facade. Architectural photography with a centered composition and convincing perspective, fine sand texture and tactile concrete. No people, signs or text.

title: 植物小店
prompt: A tiny botanical shop as a carefully built isometric clay diorama. Terracotta pots, dense varied foliage, warm light inside two windows, a small wooden door and a compact tile pavement. Pale mint studio background, soft ambient shadows, restrained handcrafted texture. Keep all objects inside the frame. No text.

title: 城市微光
prompt: 为城市夜间摄影展设计一张竖版海报。主视觉是一束橙色路灯照在湿润的深蓝街道上，倒影形成简洁几何形状。上方清晰写出标题“城市微光”，下方仅写“夜间摄影展”。中文文字准确，标题明显大于副标题，留白充足，不增加其他文字、日期、标志或水印。

title: 专注时刻
prompt: Create an editorial illustration about focused work: a small desk lamp illuminating one open notebook inside a large quiet indigo room. Place the desk in the lower right and leave generous clean space in the upper left for later typography. Paper-cut shapes, tactile grain, warm amber light against cool blue. No text or logos.

title: 阅读应用
prompt: Design one polished mobile reading-app screen on an ivory background, straight-on without device perspective. A small header reads 'Library'. Three large book-cover blocks appear below, followed by a 'Continue reading' card and a bottom navigation bar labelled 'Home', 'Library', 'Notes'. Warm charcoal typography, muted olive accents, consistent spacing, legible hierarchy. This is a visual interface concept, not a functional app.

title: 植物探险家
prompt: Create a character design sheet showing the same friendly adult botanical explorer from front, side and back. Short curly dark hair, round glasses, moss-green jacket, cream trousers, brown boots, a small orange shoulder bag. Full-body neutral poses at equal scale with clear gaps. Maintain identical clothing and accessories across views. Off-white background, clean hand-painted animation style, no labels.

title: 柠檬意面
prompt: An overhead editorial food photograph of one ceramic plate with lemon pasta, a linen napkin and a small water glass. Warm natural window light from the left, olive and cream palette, believable glossy sauce and fresh lemon zest. Asymmetric but balanced composition on a pale stone table, realistic portions, no extra cutlery, no typography.

title: MOSS品牌提案
prompt: A cohesive brand concept board for a fictional botanical stationery label called 'MOSS'. Consistent forest-green and muted terracotta palette, thoughtful paper textures, minimal botanical linework. Only the word 'MOSS' should be readable. Treat all items as one coordinated system.
